description:
You wrap yourself in a dense mantle of astral force, sharpening your defensive instincts while applying a frost aura that applies frostbite and spawns a single astral wisp each time you move to a limit of 1. 
The mantle time reduces the time takes for your attacks and movements by .15/25  by while greatly increasing your parry chance.
 It increases your magic power by 1 for each Astral Wisps within the zone
Sustaining the mantle builds Astral Fatigue, risking Overdrawn backlash if maintained too long.
This empowerment affects only you and cannot be shared.
name: Astral Mantle
